title: Mirai: future breast cancer risk from mammograms
summary: Mirai, trained on over 200,000 exams, was evaluated on hospital data from the United States, Sweden, and Taiwan. In a comparison of high-risk groups at Massachusetts General Hospital, it identified nearly twice as many future diagnoses as Tyrer-Cuzick; it does not demonstrate reduced mortality.

evidence.tested: Mirai was validated on held-out test sets from MGH, Karolinska and Chang Gung, and identified nearly twice as many future diagnoses as Tyrer-Cuzick in high-risk groups.
evidence.unknown: It does not use prior imaging and is still being validated in more diverse populations, and it does not show reduced mortality.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning predicted future breast cancer risk from mammograms.
